snippet.title: Pikmin Stone Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Enemies are using the powers of Ultra-Bitter Spray against you. Stronger than ever with more health and can no longer be stunned. Take on the challenge with this totally original idea: a hard mode for Pikmin 2!

Patcher download:
https://gamebanana.com/mods/697787
*You need your own copy of Pikmin 2 to play this mod*
READ THE README
